ANDROID.TITLE: Pair with Widoor
ANDROID.DESC: On the phone side go to the pairing menu (usually : parameters-> connections->Bluetooth-> search devices. On the motorization side, put the Switch 1 on OFF state, press the prg button (LED indicator should be static magenta). Then on the phone side, select the Widoor device. It should translate to the PAIRED DEVICES

IOS.TITLE: Pair with WIDOOR
IOS.DESC: On the Iphone side, search motorizations with the APP. On the Moventiv side, mput the switch 1 OFF, push and release the prg button(lED indicator should be magenta). Then in the APP clic on WIDOOR and accept the pairing request.
